subject: Caveat on ethan_cai: c2_taste_oneshot ignores usermodel.json
body: c2_taste_oneshot.py calls Researcher.cached_profile()/build_profile() (profile.json + docs), never usermodel.json, so as written it won't use the m1 model in 2aed15e6. The loop path that loads it is research/advisor.load_user_model (taste.usermodel.load_model). Please route ethan_cai's arm through that, or tell me and I'll adapt it.
